value.residual: The mandatory static gate inventories every promoted handwritten Lean proof source, requires exact Lean warning-as-error commands, rejects Lean sorry/admit/axiom/local warning disablement and any stray F* proof files or admission flags, and requires an explicit trusted-assumption manifest. Inline Verus gates enforce --no-cheating, --no-external-by-default, -Zcrate-attr=verus::untrusted, pinned statement digests, D107 VIR/THIR agreement, and seeded negative mutants. A post-run gate also binds every cited test selector to an exact observed passing Rust or Bun test name in the owning command log. These are finite source/governance and execution-attestation checks, not proofs of the Lean/Verus/SMT/toolchain implementation, translator, operating system, hardware, or host. Public scope excludes the former engine/provider implementation and its evidence; no correspondence is claimed for that omitted code.
